# Social Authentication

## Problem

Creating a new password adds friction before users can experience the product.

## Outcome

Users can create and access accounts with identity providers they already use.

## Scope

- Google sign-in
- Apple sign-in

## Non-goals

- SAML

## Success

A new user can reach the authenticated product without creating a password.
